title: Degree-one section compatibility of affine symmetric Proj comparison
statement: For a scheme S, quasi-coherent module E, a TautologicalQuotient D E, affine opens U <= V, and an affine comparison carrying the chart over V to the chart over U through the canonical pullback comparison, the comparison carries every degree-one unitToTwist section to the unitToTwist section of its restriction under the canonical boundary pullback identification.

proof.text: On each standard chart both sides are represented by the same degree-one fraction a/1. The homogeneous localization formula and affine tilde equivalence prove equality, and the boundary pullback comparison is the canonical unit identification.

mathlib_searches.results: Only absolute Proj chart and twist APIs; no normalized quotient comparison.
No existing theorem in Mathlib, WeilConjectures or Sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem section_compatibility_of_affine_comparison
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V)
    (c : AffineComparison E D U V h) :
    ∀ (a : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).obj V)
      (ha : a ∈ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading V 1),
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).map
          (Proj.unitToTwist ha) ≫ c.comparison.hom =
        ((Scheme.Modules.boundaryPullbackComparison
            ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjFunctor.map
              (homOfLE h))).app (Scheme.Modules.unit _) ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso
            ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjFunctor.map
              (homOfLE h))).hom ≫
        Proj.unitToTwist
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).res h |>.map_mem ha)
